name: grp2idx
expr: [g, gn] = grp2idx({'b','a','b','c'}); g1 = g(1); g4 = g(4); ng = numel(gn); c1 = double(gn{1}); c2 = double(gn{2}); [gi, gni] = grp2idx([3 1 3 2 1]); gi1 = gi(1); gi4 = gi(4); ni = numel(gni); [gn2, gnn] = grp2idx([3 1 NaN 2]); isn = double(isnan(gn2(3))); nn = numel(gnn); [gl, gln] = grp2idx(logical([1 0 1 0])); l1 = gl(1); l2 = gl(2);
comment: grp2idx multi-output [g,gn] vs MATLAB R2025b. Implemented 2026-05-30 (was an undefined function). cellstr groups in FIRST-APPEARANCE order: grp2idx({'b','a','b','c'}) -> g=[1 2 1 3] (g1=1,g4=3), gn={'b','a','c'} (ng=3, c1=98='b', c2=97='a'). numeric groups SORTED ascending, index=rank: grp2idx([3 1 3 2 1]) -> g=[3 1 3 2 1] (gi1=3,gi4=2), ni=3. NaN -> NaN index, excluded from gn: grp2idx([3 1 NaN 2]) g(3)=NaN (isn=1), nn=3. logical sorted false<true: grp2idx(logical([1 0 1 0])) -> g=[2 1 2 1] (l1=2,l2=1). namespace=descriptive. NOTE: categorical input + column-aligned char matrices not yet handled.
